# govulncheck allowlist — OSV IDs the CI vuln gate tolerates.
#
# The CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml :: vulncheck) FAILS on any *called*
# vulnerability whose ID is not listed here. New or unexpected vulnerabilities
# therefore break the build; the entries below are the known, accepted
# exceptions. One ID per line; any text after the ID is a free-form note
# (do NOT put other GO-IDs in a note — the parser greps every GO-ID on a line).
#
# Keep this list MINIMAL. Re-evaluate on every dependency bump and delete
# entries as fixes land. Tracking: ENG-415.
#
# ── Category A: no upstream fix available (govulncheck "Fixed in: N/A") ──────
# The OSV records list no patched github.com/docker/docker version; their fix
# is tracked under the separate github.com/moby/moby/v2 module. Both advisories
# remain in the called set through Docker client operations, including image
# inspection, container creation, and cleanup. Their module-wide matches do not
# establish that Fred executes the affected daemon plugin code. Keep them while
# measuring the legacy dependency's removal; deleting them alone fails the gate.
#
# Fred's direct legacy client calls live in the Docker lifecycle and imageexec
# boundaries; compose v5 and docker/cli v29 use github.com/moby/moby/client.
# Consolidating those boundaries onto the newer SDK remains worth measuring:
# buildx still reaches docker/docker via pkg/namesgenerator, and both
# advisories are module-granularity (empty ecosystem_specific), so any linkage
# may keep them called. Measure with govulncheck before assuming.
GO-2026-4887   legacy docker/docker module — no patched version in the OSV record
GO-2026-4883   legacy docker/docker module — no patched version in the OSV record
#
# golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained/frozen ("Fixed in: N/A"); its OSV
# entry has `introduced: 0` with no `fixed` event at all, so no release will
# ever clear it. fred reaches only the openpgp/armor ASCII-encoding envelope via
# cosmos-sdk keyring ExportPrivKeyArmor/ImportPrivKey
# (internal/chain/signer_pool.go), not openpgp message/signature crypto.
GO-2026-5932   x/crypto/openpgp unmaintained — reached only via cosmos-sdk keyring armor
#
# ── Category B is empty. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# It previously deferred the containerd/buildkit fixes that sat behind the
# docker/compose v2 toolchain. ENG-642 moved Fred to docker/compose v5, permitting
# patched containerd/buildkit selections. Those entries left the called set.
# Do not re-add a blanket "compose-coupled" justification: check the graph of the
# specific version you need.
